message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The test uses JUnit 5 (jupiter) and Mockito. In the environment, maybe those dependencies aren't present. But we can modify test to use JUnit 4 (org.junit) and Mockito static methods from org.mockito.Mockito, and remove JUnit5 annotations. Simpler: replace JUnit5 imports with JUnit 4 equivalents: @Test from org.junit.Test, @Before, @After, etc. Also static imports for assertions: org.junit.Assert.*. Also remove @ExtendWith and @Mock annotation; we can manually create mock using Mockito.mock. Use MockitoAnnotations.initMocks? Simpler: in setup, create mock via mock(Indicator.class). So we don't need @Mock annotation.

Also remove duplicate imports and NaN import issues. DecimalNum.NaN exists? In ta4j library, DecimalNum.NaN is a static field. The code uses DecimalNum.NaN; earlier they attempted static import of NaN.NaN incorrectly. We'll just use DecimalNum.NaN.

Also anyInt() is from Mockito's ArgumentMatchers.anyInt(). Need static import.

Also times() from Mockito.

Also reset from Mockito.

Also verify from Mockito.

Thus modify imports accordingly.

Also remove duplicate imports.

Also adjust @BeforeEach to @Before, @AfterEach to @After.

Also remove @ExtendWith.

Also adjust test methods to use JUnit4 @Test.

Also remove assertThrows which is JUnit5; JUnit4 has expected attribute or try-catch. Use @Test(expected = NullPointerException.class) for those tests. For lambda version, we can use try-catch and fail.

Implement changes.

Also need to ensure NumericIndicator.of(delegate) works with mock.

Now produce corrected test code.
